common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

help.title: Need help?
help.body: Full request and response reference, with copy-able examples for every endpoint.

page.title: Developer
page.lead: Generate a key to call the REST API from your own apps, CRM or automation: send messages, manage contacts, templates, broadcasts and more. One key per workspace.

forbidden.title: You cannot view API keys
forbidden.body: Your role does not include access to API keys. Ask a workspace admin to give you the API keys permission.

banner.title: Your new API key
banner.warning: Copy this now and store it safely. For your security we only keep a hash, so it will never be shown again.

key.title: Your API key
key.fullAccessHint: This key can use every endpoint of the REST API. To limit what a key can do, revoke it and create a new one with Restrict this key turned on.
key.noRevoke: Your role cannot revoke API keys.
key.revoked: API key revoked. Any app using it will stop working immediately.
key.footer: Only one key is allowed per workspace. Revoke this one to issue a new key.

confirm.title: Revoke this key?
confirm.message: Any app or integration using this key will immediately stop working. This cannot be undone. You can create a new key afterwards.

create.title: Create your key
create.help: Give the key a name so you remember where it is used. The key is shown once on creation.
create.name: Key name

restrict.label: Restrict this key
restrict.help: Off: the key has full access to the REST API. On: it can only use the scopes you tick below.

create.created: API key created. Copy it now - it won't be shown again.
create.noCreate: Your role cannot create API keys. Ask a workspace admin.
create.planLocked: Your plan does not include the REST API.

errors.required: Enter a name for the key.
errors.tooLong: The name can be at most 120 characters.
errors.noScopes: Tick at least one scope, or turn off Restrict this key.

quickstart.title: Quickstart
quickstart.intro: Send your first message. Replace the key and recipient:

errors.planLimit: You already have an active API key. Revoke it before creating a new one - only one key per workspace is allowed.
errors.planLocked: Your plan does not include the REST API. Upgrade to create API keys.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.validation: The key name is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.notFound: That key no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.loadFailed: Could not load your API key.
